s:
Assertion (A): Earth’s axial tilt is 23½° from the perpendicular to the orbital plane.
Reason (R): Earth’s axial tilt is responsible for the seasons.

Match List-I with List-II:

List-I
(a) Equinox

(i) Latitude 23½°S
(ii) Sun overhead at the Equator
(iii) Latitude 23½°N
